utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I checked the wiring list, and I’ll let Hana know if anything looks off. Oren can help sort donations or carry supplies if we need him.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, and Tess already confirmed the repair drive is still happening, yes?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, Tess confirmed it’s still on. I’ll keep an eye on the wiring list and flag Hana if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Gus can bring a couple of bins and help load things up, and he has a few tools I can borrow for the repair drive. Rey’s also free most afternoons this week if we need help with pickups or repairs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great — I’ll pass the remaining repair tasks along and keep everyone in the loop. If anything else comes up, I can help connect the right people.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep an eye on the pickups and tool needs so we don’t miss anything. If anything shifts, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m checking the community hall first, then the corner garden shed. Bo’s helping me, and Opal’s keeping track of the locations.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’ll make the supply list and check in with the tool folks today. Faye can help spread the word at school drop-off too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara — that’ll help a lot. I’ll let you know what we find at the hall and shed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll check with Nell about whether we still need donations, and Hana can confirm the start time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll keep an eye out for small useful things and drop them by Uli’s gate. If Leo still needs hands, I can sort donations or help carry supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren — I’ll ask Nell if we still need donations, and Hana will confirm the start time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll ask around while I’m out running errands and check in with a few folks. I’ll report back if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll drop by the repair drive and mention it to a few neighbors. Then I’ll gather the remaining repair tasks and send them over to Jules so they can match folks up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll keep asking around and let you know if I hear anything useful while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. The gate drop-off is fine for little useful things, and I’m grateful Oren and Ira are helping out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep Gus and Kira posted if anything changes. And Gus said he can lend a few tools if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s very kind of Gus. Thank you, Tess — I’ll keep an eye on the gate drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll ask around at the repair drive to see where help’s needed most, and I’ll let Mina know whether donations are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good. Let’s make a clear list of what’s broken and what tools we need, then we can decide what gets fixed today and what can wait.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good idea — I’ll check around for the biggest needs and bring back a clear update for Mina too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m helping Rosa pull together a quick list of what we need and who’s bringing what. I can skim it fast if you want.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure — send it over and I’ll check what I can cover. I can also bring a couple bins and help load things up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Gus — bins and loading help are both on the list. I’ll send the quick item list over now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Leo will check the wiring list and let us know if anything looks off.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll spread the word around the block, and Quinn can keep me posted on who’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that works — just have Quinn keep an eye on the names, and I’ll wait for Leo’s report on the wiring list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check what we already have and note anything still missing for the repair drive. Then I can tell Noah what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds great—I’ll keep tracking the locations so we stay organized. Rosa is starting at the community hall, then the corner garden shed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—I’ll finish the supply check and send Noah the missing items once I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning from 9 to 12 works for me. I can help spread the word at school drop-off and coordinate around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye — that helps a lot. I’m glad Cleo’s checking supplies, and I can ask around at the drive to see where help’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll mention it at drop-off and keep an eye on the school schedule so it doesn’t conflict with anything. Thanks, Noah.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word about the repair drive. And once Dane’s back by the block, I’ll make sure he hears about it too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll check the supplies and note anything we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good—I’ll let folks nearby know and keep an ear out for Dane. If you spot any gaps in supplies, just tell me and I’ll help spread that too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check what we already have and figure out what’s still needed for the repair drive. I can let you know what’s missing once I’ve looked.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t know the hours offhand, but I can swing by the garage and bring over anything useful I find. If you need, I can ask around for the drop-off timing too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess — that would help a lot. If you can bring whatever useful supplies you find, I’ll check what’s still missing and let you know the rest.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll ask around while I’m out running errands and check in with a few folks. If I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll report back.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep tracking the repair drive locations here. Rosa’s checking the community hall first, then the corner garden shed, so I’ll stay on top of where things are happening.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep asking around while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — can you let me know if donations are still needed?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — I’ll check around at the repair drive and let you know if donations are still needed. I’ll also ask where help is needed most.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. I appreciate it — just let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll start the list and jot down the tools we already have for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I can lend a few tools if you need them, and I can also bring a couple bins to help load everything up. Tess will let me know what’s still needed as soon as she hears, so we can keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s helpful, thanks. I’ll note the bins and wait for Tess’s update on what else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. If anyone has small useful things to spare, they can leave them at my gate drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll let folks know to leave any small useful items at your gate. And I’ll keep an eye out for anyone back by the block who can help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning from 9 to 12 works well for me. I can help spread the word at school drop-off and coordinate around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good. Let’s make a clear list of what’s broken and what tools we’ll need, then we can decide what to fix today and what can wait.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great idea—I’ll make a simple list and ask around at drop-off for anything else that needs fixing. Then we can sort the urgent stuff from the can-wait items.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can sort donations or help carry supplies. I’ll also look for any small useful things and drop them by Uli’s gate.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — I’ll check the supplies and note anything we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I might forget a bit, but I’ll keep an eye out and leave anything useful by Uli’s gate.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — Leo will check the wiring list and report anything off.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot. If Gus can bring the bins and a few tools, we should be able to keep the loading organized.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I’ll ask Gus to bring the bins and a few tools so we can keep the loading organized.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll spread the word around the block. Quinn and I can keep each other posted on who’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks. I’m still putting together the quick list of needed items and who’s bringing what for Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — Mara’s handling the supply list and tool check-ins today, and Quinn’s already starting to reach folks now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Cleo’s checking the supplies — that’s a big help. Glad folks are gathering things and helping with the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, exactly — Vik’s sending me the remaining repair tasks, and I’ll keep everyone in the loop. Ira’s out running errands too, so we’re piecing it together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — sounds like it’s all coming together, even if I missed a few pieces. Let me know if you still need anything from me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll make the supply list and check in with the tool folks today. Faye can help spread the word at school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check the wiring list and let Hana know if anything looks off. Oren can also sort donations or help carry supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, that covers a lot. I’ll keep on the supply list and tool folks, and Faye can handle the school drop-off word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it’s still happening. I’m checking the community hall first, then the corner garden shed, and Opal is tracking the locations while Bo is helping me organize it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — so Sam’s helping too, right?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
